note: D274 · the visual-system lint lands with a baseline, or it lands nothing. Each entry is the number of pre-system sites a check found on the day it was written; the check FAILS when the count rises and reports the new floor when it falls. Lower the number in the same commit that lowers the count. A baseline of 0 is zero-tolerance from then on, and the entry stays so the intent is on the record.
